title: Geno's Mythos
description:
A Minecraft mod that adds a diverse set of items, weapons, and a custom dimension.


This mod will not receive any further updates, as I cannot find out how to fix this one error which came out of literally nowhere.
body:
I decided to add a couple of items from Geno's Mythos which is a bunch of stories, or myths, really. This includes things like:
Virinium Scythe

A scythe forged with virinium, capable of inflicting Viriniotoxemia—virinium blood poisoning—on its target. On hit, it also knocks back and damages nearby enemies in a small radius.
Ignited Blade of Orin

A searing blade once wielded by the fire god Orin. Its strikes apply Heartburn, a lingering internal heat that scorches from within.
Dinson’s Staff

A mystical staff that, when activated, summons a ring of water around the wielder. Can be used in quick succession.

No deep lore explanations here, just cool stuff from weird tales.

The mod is buggy. Not game-destroying (hopefully), but don’t expect polish. Still, to my knowledge, everything that’s supposed to work, works.

No Fabric version will be made, unless I suddenly decide I enjoy pain. It’s for 1.20.1 only — try it on other versions if you want, but don’t blame me when it breaks.

All current textures are beta, and are subject to change.

This mod will not receive any further updates, as I cannot find out how to fix this one error which came out of literally nowhere.

I have seen a lot of scraping sites recently re-host my mod(s) without my permission, if you are downloading my mods on any other site, than Curseforge or Modrinth, there is a 100% chance that it is either malicious, or a cash-grab. While I do my best to take these down all by myself, I cannot do it fast enough.
